desc_en: Sophistication begins at the first layer. This exclusive piece features a rich sapphire blue background with a central motif fusing a textured kiss with diamond geometry. Crafted from high-density cotton, they offer an impeccable anatomical fit that naturally contours the silhouette. A bold yet refined proposition that redefines essential lingerie with a distinctly contemporary character and absolute comfort.
